prompt: briefly Identify and explain the uses of the natural resource coal in Canada in a single paragraph formation
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the most accurate and on-topic, mainly describing coal’s uses in Canada for electricity generation (thermal coal) and steelmaking via coke (metallurgical coal), with appropriate context. Candidate 4 includes a likely incorrect factual claim about coal generating ~40% of Canada’s electricity, which substantially undermines correctness. Candidate 2 and 3 cover the main uses more generally but add several questionable or overreaching applications (e.g., consumer products, specific alloymaking role of coal, and coal-to-liquids) without strong support. Overall, Candidate 1 best matches the prompt with the fewest problematic details.
